exposure: Teenage deliveries were analyzed by age, ethnicity, gravida, para, period of gestation, mode of delivery, maternal or neonatal complications, and birth weight.
cohort: 7054 deliveries at Okhaldhunga Community Hospital, Nepal, from July 2007 to July 2017
finding: The prevalence of teenage pregnancy at Okhaldhunga Community Hospital was 29.06%, higher than the national figure, with common complications including low birth weight babies, premature delivery, and perineal and cervical tears.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was a common complication in teenage deliveries.
